points.name: be 动词
points.rule: I 用 am，he / she / it 和单数名词用 is，you / we / they 和复数名词用 are。
points.example: I am a student. / She is my sister. / They are in the classroom.

points.name: 人称代词主格
points.rule: 做主语用主格：I / you / he / she / it / we / they。
points.example: He is my friend. / We are good at English.

points.name: 形容词性物主代词
points.rule: 表示「谁的」，后面必须跟名词：my / your / his / her / its / our / their。
points.example: This is my book. / Their teacher is very kind.

points.name: 名词复数
points.rule: 一般加 -s；以 s、x、ch、sh 结尾加 -es；辅音字母 + y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 -es；foot→feet、child→children 等为不规则变化。
points.example: three boxes / two feet / many children

points.name: 冠词 a / an / the
points.rule: 辅音音素开头用 a，元音音素开头用 an，特指或独一无二的事物用 the。
points.example: an apple / a book / the sun

points.name: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
points.rule: 主语是 he / she / it 或单数名词时，动词加 -s 或 -es；其余人称用原形。
points.example: He goes to school by bus. / My mother cooks dinner at six.

points.name: 现在进行时
points.rule: be（am / is / are）+ 动词 -ing，表示此刻正在发生。
points.example: The boys are playing football. / I am doing my homework now.

points.name: there be 句型
points.rule: 表示「某处有某物」，be 动词与**紧跟其后的第一个名词**保持一致（就近原则）。
points.example: There is a book and two pens on the desk. / There are two pens and a book.

points.name: 一般疑问句
points.rule: 实义动词用 Do / Does 提问，be 动词或情态动词直接提到句首。
points.example: Do you like apples? / Does he play basketball?

points.name: 特殊疑问词
points.rule: what 问什么、when 问时间、where 问地点、who 问人、how 问方式、why 问原因。
points.example: When is your birthday? / How do you go to school?

points.name: 情态动词 can / must / may
points.rule: 后面一律接动词原形，没有人称变化；must 表必须，may 表允许或请求。
points.example: You must finish your homework first. / May I use your pen?

points.name: 介词 in / on / at
points.rule: in 用于大范围（月、年、城市），on 用于具体某天或表面，at 用于具体时刻或小地点。
points.example: The book is on the desk. / I get up at seven o'clock.

points.name: some / any
points.rule: some 多用于肯定句，any 多用于否定句和疑问句。
points.example: I have some water. / Do you have any questions?

points.name: 可数与不可数名词
points.rule: 不可数名词（bread / milk / water / news）没有复数，也不能直接加 a / an，要用 some 或量词。
points.example: There is some bread on the table.

points.name: 频度副词
points.rule: always > usually > often > sometimes > never，放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
points.example: He is never late for school.

points.name: 形容词比较级与最高级
points.rule: 两者比较用 -er / more，三者及以上用 -est / most；good→better→best、bad→worse→worst。
points.example: Tom is taller than his brother. / This is the best book I have read.

points.name: 一般过去时
points.rule: 规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词要单独记（go→went、do→did）；时间状语多为 yesterday、last night。
points.example: I went to the park yesterday. / She did her homework last night.

points.name: 一般将来时
points.rule: will + 动词原形表示将来；be going to 表示有计划或已有迹象。
points.example: We will visit the museum tomorrow. / Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.

points.name: 现在完成时
points.rule: have / has + 过去分词，表示过去发生且对现在有影响，或从过去持续到现在（常配 since / for）。
points.example: I have seen this film twice. / He has lived in Beijing since 2019.

points.name: 被动语态
points.rule: be + 过去分词；一般现在时用 am / is / are + 过去分词，一般过去时用 was / were + 过去分词。
points.example: The window was broken by Tom yesterday. / English is spoken in many countries.

points.name: 动词不定式
points.rule: want / hope / ask / decide 等动词后接 to + 动词原形。
points.example: I want to be a doctor. / He asked me to help him.

points.name: 宾语从句
points.rule: 从句一律用陈述语序（连接词 + 主语 + 谓语），不能用疑问语序；「是否」用 if 或 whether。
points.example: Could you tell me where the bank is? / I don't know whether he will come.

items.point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
items.explain: 主语 my mother 是第三人称单数，动词加 -s。

now 表示此刻正在做，主语 I 用 am doing。

items.stem: There ___ a book and two pens on the desk.
items.explain: 就近原则：紧跟 be 的是 a book（单数），所以用 is。

items.stem: There ___ some milk in the glass.
items.explain: milk 是不可数名词，按单数处理，用 is。
主语 you，实义动词 like，用 Do 提问。
主语 he 是第三人称单数，用 Does，后面动词还原。

items.stem: ___ do you go to school? — By bike.
items.explain: 答语 By bike 说的是方式，用 how 提问。

items.point: 情态动词 can / must / may
items.explain: 表示「必须」用 must，后面接动词原形。

items.point: 情态动词 can / must / may
items.explain: 礼貌地请求允许用 May I…。

items.stem: The book is ___ the desk. （在桌面上）
items.explain: 在物体表面上用 on。
具体时刻前用 at。

items.stem: I have ___ water in my bottle.
items.explain: 肯定句里用 some。

items.stem: There is some ___ on the table.
items.explain: bread 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

items.stem: He is ___ late for school. （从不）
items.explain: 「从不」是 never，放在 be 动词之后。

items.point: 形容词比较级与最高级
items.explain: 两者比较用比较级 taller，后面跟 than。

items.point: 形容词比较级与最高级
items.stem: This is the ___ book I have ever read.
items.explain: 三者以上比较用最高级，good 的最高级是 best。
yesterday 表示过去，go 的过去式是 went。
last night 表示过去，do 的过去式是 did。
tomorrow 表示将来，用 will + 动词原形。

items.stem: Look at the clouds. It ___ rain.
items.explain: 已有明显迹象（乌云）时用 be going to。
twice 强调到现在为止的经历，用 have + 过去分词。
since + 时间点表示持续到现在，主语 he 用 has lived。
窗户是被打破的，过去时被动语态 was + 过去分词。
英语是被说的，一般现在时被动语态 is + 过去分词。
want 后面接 to + 动词原形。
ask sb. to do sth. 是固定搭配。
宾语从句必须用陈述语序：连接词 + 主语 + 谓语。

items.stem: I don't know ___ he will come or not.
items.explain: 后面有 or not 时只能用 whether。
